1st_edition.notes: Small black circle with '1' and 'EDITION' text, left side below artwork

unlimited.description: Explicitly unlimited print (no 1st Ed stamp, not shadowless)
unlimited.notes: Same as normal for pricing; distinct for collector grading

shadowless.description: No drop shadow on right/bottom card frame border
shadowless.notes: Only Base Set. Printed between 1st Edition and standard Unlimited runs.

reverse_holofoil.description: Holographic on everything except artwork (fireworks/cosmic pattern)
reverse_holofoil.notes: Legendary Collection has unique 'fireworks' pattern. e-Card sets have 'cosmic' pattern.

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol and 'PROMO' text
promo.notes: WotC Black Star Promos. Large black star with PROMO text in bottom-right of card.

reverse_holofoil.description: Reverse holo with set logo stamp on artwork
reverse_holofoil.notes: All EX main sets have reverse holo. EX Team Rocket Returns (ex7) through EX Power Keepers (ex16) have stamped set logo on artwork bottom-right.

stamped.description: Reverse holo with set logo stamp overlaid on card art
stamped.notes: EX Team Rocket Returns through EX Power Keepers. Stamp is set logo in bottom-right of artwork area. This is a sub-type of reverse_holofoil in pricing (same TCGCSV subtype) but visually distinct and collectible.

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol in bottom-right
promo.notes: Nintendo Black Star Promos. Star symbol appears in bottom-right corner near card number.

reverse_holofoil.description: Reverse holo on entire card except artwork, non-patterned rainbow sheen
reverse_holofoil.notes: No set logo stamp. Clean rainbow holographic sheen on border/text areas.

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol in bottom-right

reverse_holofoil.description: Reverse holo, vertical rainbow pattern on border/text
reverse_holofoil.notes: Continues the DP-era clean rainbow sheen style. LEGEND cards are holo-only (no reverse).

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol in bottom-right

reverse_holofoil.description: Reverse holo with type-colored tinsel pattern (horizontal stripes)
reverse_holofoil.notes: BW Base Set has plain type-colored sheen. BW2+ have type symbol pattern. Legendary Treasures (bw11) included Radiant Collection subset.

full_art.description: Full art EX cards, artwork extends to card edges
full_art.notes: First era with full art cards. Pokemon-EX full arts and full art Supporters introduced.

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol in bottom-right

reverse_holofoil.description: Reverse holo with type symbol pattern (same style as BW era)
reverse_holofoil.notes: Continues BW-era type symbol pattern. Evolutions (xy12) has unique holo style as a throwback.

full_art.description: Full art EX/BREAK/Mega cards, artwork extends to edges
full_art.notes: Pokemon-EX, Mega EX, and BREAK full arts. Also full art Supporters and Items.

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol in bottom-right

reverse_holofoil.description: Reverse holo with type symbol rows and large type symbol bottom-right
reverse_holofoil.notes: Distinctive pattern: horizontal rows of type symbols with one large symbol in bottom-right corner.

full_art.description: Full art GX/Ultra Beast/Tag Team/Trainer cards

gold.description: Gold/secret rare - entire card dominated by gold hue including borders
gold.notes: First era with gold secret rares. Gold energy cards, gold Pokemon-GX, gold trainer items.

rainbow_rare.description: Rainbow rare - high saturation across multiple hue peaks, rainbow texture
rainbow_rare.notes: Hyper Rare / Rainbow Rare cards. Full art with rainbow foil texture across entire card.

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol in bottom-left
promo.notes: Sun & Moon Black Star Promos. Star symbol appears in bottom-left corner.

reverse_holofoil.description: Reverse holo with chevron/type symbol pattern
reverse_holofoil.notes: Upward-facing chevrons containing type symbol repeated across card. Criticized for making text hard to read.

full_art.notes: V, VMAX, VSTAR full arts. Alt art variants (alternate illustration V/VMAX) are highly valued.

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol in bottom-left

holofoil.description: Holographic artwork (cosmos holo pattern on rares)
holofoil.notes: SV rares use cosmos holo pattern by default. Different from traditional holo.

reverse_holofoil.description: Reverse holo with type-specific pattern (lightning bolts, leaves, etc.)
reverse_holofoil.notes: Type-specific patterns: Lightning type has lightning bolts, Grass has leaves, etc. Pebble-like shapes with type symbol in circle.

full_art.description: Illustration Rare / Special Illustration Rare / Art Rare cards
full_art.notes: Illustration Rare (single gold star): Pokemon in natural environments. Special Illustration Rare (double gold star): chase cards with glitter foil. Special Art Rare for ex and Supporters.

gold.description: Hyper Rare / gold-bordered secret rare cards
gold.notes: Triple gold star rarity. Full-art foil with gilded borders and accents.

rainbow_rare.description: Rainbow rare cards (less common in SV than SM/SWSH)
rainbow_rare.notes: Less common in SV era. Some sets may not include rainbow rares.

promo.description: Black Star Promo with star symbol in bottom-left

stamped_sets.description: Sets where reverse holo cards have a set logo stamp overlaid on the card artwork. The stamp appears in the bottom-right area of the artwork window.
stamped_sets.notes: EX Ruby & Sapphire (ex1) through EX FireRed & LeafGreen (ex6) did NOT have stamped reverse holos. The stamp was introduced with EX Team Rocket Returns (ex7). All reverse holos in stamped sets have the stamp; it is not a separate pricing variant but a visual sub-type of reverse_holofoil.

default.description: No detection needed; card is normal if no other variant detected

holo_detector.description: HSV hue spread + spatial noise analysis to detect holographic prismatic reflections
holo_detector.notes: Distinguishes holo (art only) vs reverse holo (border only) by comparing signal in art vs border regions

stamp_ocr.description: PaddleOCR on stamp region looking for '1st' and 'edition' text + circular blob detection
stamp_ocr.region_format: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of card dimensions

stamped_detector.description: Detect EX-era set logo stamp on reverse holo card artwork using OCR + template matching
stamped_detector.notes: Stamp is semi-transparent set logo in bottom-right of artwork. Uses OCR to read stamp text and match against known set names.

edge_gradient.description: Right/bottom border gradient analysis to detect shadowless cards (no drop shadow)
edge_gradient.notes: Shadowless cards lack the dark gradient on right and bottom card edges that standard Unlimited prints have

full_art_detector.description: Edge strip analysis: high saturation + hue variance in outer 5% strip indicates artwork extends to borders
full_art_detector.notes: Requires 3/4 edge strips passing. Era-gated to era 5+ (BW onward).

gold_detector.description: HSV analysis for gold-dominant color (hue 15-45) covering >40% of card surface

rainbow_detector.description: High saturation spread across 4+ of 6 hue segments indicates rainbow foil

promo_detector.description: Detect black star promo symbol via contour solidity analysis in the card number region
promo_detector.notes: Black star shape has low solidity (0.25-0.40) vs normal set symbols (0.55+). Position varies by era: WotC=mid-right, EX-XY=bottom-right, SM-SV=bottom-left. WotC fallback uses OCR for 'PROMO' text.
